## Defect

The SAME issue as `anchored-marker-queues`, authored the ADR-122 (3) way: the machine
truth is the fenced block at the TOP, and the body carries NO bare `alert-fp:` line for
the legacy reader to find. Everything the debouncer decides with must come out of the
block — lane membership, the self-referential split, the currency fingerprint.

Touches: agents/coordinator/fix-debounce-argo.yaml, agents/replay/

(The `Touches:` line is deliberately still legacy: fix-debounce's footprint read is the
one grammar in this file NOT yet on the parser — its `^[Tt]ouches:` column-0 form has no
entry in issue_body.py's LEGACY table, so migrating it would silently WIDEN a gate.)
